column1: # 10021 — X-Content-Type-Options: Spring Security sets this automatically.
# 10035 — Strict-Transport-Security: only on HTTPS; this is a dev-mode HTTP target.
# 10054 — Cookie without SameSite: app uses JWT Bearer tokens, not cookies.
# 10055 — CSP: Script-src includes unsafe-inline: not relevant for a pure JSON API.
# 10096 — Timestamp Disclosure: epoch-ms in JSON responses; not a vulnerability.
